title: Grandpa's Hoco Proposal
trend: TikTok 'Homecoming Proposal Reveal' (October 2026) — creators film their hoco proposal sign with a pun, then the big moment of the answer
description:
Jayden helps his grandpa ask Lorraine to the senior center homecoming dance. The pumpkin did not agree to any of this.

#hocoproposal #homecoming #hoco #grandpa #comedy #animation #shorts
tiktok_caption: grandpa's hoco proposal 🎃 senior center edition #hocoproposal #homecoming #hoco #grandpa #fyp

lines.text: It's hoco proposal season, and my grandpa is asking someone to the dance.
Not someone. Lorraine. I have waved at her every single morning for years.
Step one of a hoco proposal. You need a sign with a pun on it.
Which is why I have been painted. Without permission. On my face.
You're a pumpkin. Your whole job is to sit on a porch and be read.
Okay, let's hear the puns. Grandpa, you go first.
Lorraine, I'd be gourd to go to the dance with you.
Gourd. Like good. But with a gourd.
That one is going on the maybe pile.
Lorraine, let's make this dance un-be-leaf-able.
That's a leaf pun, Grandpa. You painted a leaf pun on a pumpkin.
I ran out of pumpkin puns at four in the morning.
He was up all night whispering at me with a paintbrush. Not cozy.
Step two. We rehearse. I'll be Lorraine. You knock, and I open the door.
Knock knock.
Who is it?
It's Walter. Will you go to homecoming with me? Yes or no. Thank you.
Grandpa, that was a job interview.
Okay. Where are the flowers? You need flowers.
I have a coupon for flowers.
He is going to hand her a coupon. I have seen more romance in a compost bin.
New plan. You hold the sign, she reads it, she says yes. I film it.
Okay. Porch light is on. She's home. Go, go, go.
Hold the pumpkin higher. She has to read it from the door.
Please do not lift me by the stem. That is my hair.
Walter? Why are you knocking on your own front door?
Ma'am, I'm just a bush. Please continue.
Lorraine. I have prepared a question. And a pumpkin.
The pumpkin says, un-be-leaf-able.
I told him. I told him at four in the morning.
Lorraine, will you go to the senior center homecoming dance with me?
Walter, I have one question first.
Anything.
Is that a coupon in your hand?
It's twenty percent off flowers. The flowers are implied.
We are losing her.
Walter. We have been married for fifty one years.
Wait. What?
Of course we're married. Who did you think Lorraine was?
Grandma! Her name is Grandma!
In nineteen seventy four, I asked him to a dance. He has never asked me to anything.
I wanted it to be perfect.
It is not perfect. There is a leaf pun on a pumpkin.
It's perfect. Yes, Walter. I will go to the dance with you.
She said yes! Jayden, clap!
Now, Jayden. Who are you taking to homecoming?
Oh. I haven't asked anybody yet.
Step one. You need a sign with a pun on it.
I'll get the paint.
Absolutely not. I am moving to the neighbors' porch.
